Saudamini Mishra.

Known as Dhi.

Author. Inventor. The person behind Dhi’s Clock.

Her work explores a personal question: how do we understand our own time, and what might it help us see?

Discover her work

An idea about time.
Made personal.

Dhi’s Clock brings Saudamini’s concept of birthday-based guidance into a personalised timepiece. It offers daily, monthly and yearly prompts for when to begin, pursue, bring something to a close or retreat.

Through the clock and her writing, Dhi invites a different way of looking at life’s changing cycles.

Explore the clock

The ideas.
The writing.
The conversations.

Dhi’s published work brings her ideas about personal time to the page. Her book Dhi’s Clock was featured at the New Delhi World Book Fair in January 2026, alongside an opportunity to meet the author.
